name: Eda Framework
description: Produces a structured exploratory data analysis report covering row counts, column inventory, missing values, distributions, and frequency counts. Translates raw data into a complete EDA summary with specific findings, not generic descriptions. Use when the user has a dataset and wants to understand its structure, quality, and key characteristics before deeper analysis. Do NOT use for hypothesis testing (use hypothesis-testing), data cleaning operations (use data-cleaning-protocol), or building predictive models (use regression-guide).
